messages:
Maya (AE): Quasar Labs just raised an exec escalation. CTO wants an on-the-record bridge today. POC blockers: SSO assertion failing, unexpected p95 regression when clients send mixed short/long prompts, and procurement asked for a 30-day pilot price vs annual commit. Need owners and quick plan.

Diego (Presales): I'll own pricing and slide for the bridge. Quick ask: do we have sample traffic profile? Their infra sent a CSV but want redacted example.

Iris (SRE): I pulled the POC logs: when session mixes short (<=64) and long (>1024) requests, KV cache churn spikes and p95 climbs. Repro script ready. Can run a 10-min perf with kv-prefetch enabled.

Omar (Security): On SSO: failure looks like audience mismatch + cert chain issue. Ask Quasar for IdP metadata (XML) and the raw SAML response (redacted). If they're asking BYO-KMS, legal needs DPA addendum.

Lena (Legal): Noted. We can fast-track a limited DPA addendum for pilot BYO-KMS, but need scope: what data access and rotation controls. Also, procurement's month-to-month request needs approval from pricing.

BridgeBot: Bridge created: BR-9973. Tentative 16:00 PT. Use /bridge confirm to update.

Maya (AE): Owners: Diego=pricing; Iris=SRE perf + canary; Omar=SSO troubleshooting; Lena=legal/KMS path. Can someone draft a 1-line for the exec invite summarizing the fix plan?

Diego (Presales): One-liner draft: "Run focused canary with kv-prefetch, complete SSO metadata exchange, and present a 30-day pilot pricing option for accelerated POC closure."

Iris (SRE): Kicking off perf: 
```
./perf_run --target https://poc.quasar.redwood/generate --concurrency 60 --seq-mix "short:70,long:30" --enable-kv-prefetch
```
Posting results in ~12m.

Omar (Security): Quasar sent IdP metadata (sanitized) via email. Maya, can you paste the ACS URL here? Need to confirm AudienceURI.

Maya (AE): ACS: https://login.quasar.example/saml/acs. Pasting minimal metadata snippet in DM to Omar.

Iris (SRE): Tail: [2026-03-23T15:02Z] run=prf-77 p95=670ms kv_miss=24%; [2026-03-23T15:14Z] run=prf-78 p95=360ms kv_miss=5.6% (after kv-prefetch). CSV: https://perf.redwood/runs/prf-77.csv

Diego (Presales): I'll draft the 30-day pilot numbers and include a convertible commit option. ETA: 45m.

Lena (Legal): I'll prepare the DPA addendum template for BYO-KMS and share comments on scope. If Quasar wants HSM-backed keys, flag here.

BridgeBot: Reminder: BR-9973 in 10 minutes.

Maya (AE): Thanks team. Plan for bridge: SRE shows canary numbers, Security confirms SSO steps, Presales presents pilot pricing, Legal outlines DPA path. Invite sent to Quasar CTO + procurement + our execs.

Diego (Presales): Post-bridge note: Quasar accepted the canary numbers and wants pilot contract. Procurement asked for written pilot T&C; I'll post draft in morning. :thumbsup:

Maya (AE): Closing loop: good work. Follow-ups tracked in BR-9973 notes.
